name: Multi Currency Template MT5
summary: This is a multi-currency Expert Advisor template for MT5 that allows simultaneous trading across multiple currency pairs from a single chart. It provides a framework for applying trading signals to multiple symbols with configurable parameters for each pair.
summary_zh: 这是一个MT5多货币对EA模板，允许从单一图表同时交易多个货币对。它提供了将交易信号应用于多个交易品种的框架，并为每个货币对提供可配置参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个多货币对交易模板，核心概念是在单一图表上监控和交易多个品种。入场条件取决于用户在模板中实现的具体信号逻辑，模板本身提供了多品种数据获取和信号触发的框架结构。出场条件同样依赖用户自定义的逻辑，但模板包含了标准的平仓机制。仓位管理通过可配置的手数参数实现，允许为不同货币对设置不同的交易量。资金管理方面，模板提供了基本的账户余额和保证金检查机制。作为一个模板框架，其策略逻辑需要用户自行填充，但多品种并行处理和多时间框架分析的基础架构已经搭建完成，支持同时监控多个市场的交易机会。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a multi-currency trading template whose core concept is monitoring and trading multiple symbols from a single chart. Entry conditions depend on the specific signal logic implemented by the user within the template framework, which provides the infrastructure for multi-symbol data retrieval and signal triggering. Exit conditions similarly rely on user-defined logic, though the template includes standard position closing mechanisms. Position sizing is handled through configurable lot size parameters, allowing different trade volumes for different currency pairs. For money management, the template provides basic account balance and margin check mechanisms. As a template framework, the strategy logic needs to be filled in by the user, but the multi-symbol parallel processing and multi-timeframe analysis architecture is already built, supporting simultaneous monitoring of trading opportunities across multiple markets.
pros: 支持多货币对并行交易，提高资金利用效率和交易机会覆盖面
模板化设计便于用户快速定制自己的多品种交易策略
单一图表运行多个品种，节省图表资源和管理成本
提供了标准化的止损止盈和资金管理框架
多时间框架分析能力有助于提高信号可靠性
pros_en: Supports multi-currency parallel trading, improving capital efficiency and market coverage
Template-based design allows users to quickly customize their own multi-symbol strategies
Running multiple symbols from a single chart saves chart resources and management overhead
Provides standardized stop-loss, take-profit, and money management framework
Multi-timeframe analysis capability helps improve signal reliability
cons: 作为模板，核心交易策略逻辑需要用户自行开发，缺少即用型信号系统
多品种同时交易可能导致保证金不足风险，尤其在波动市场
缺少高级风险控制机制如最大回撤限制和相关性过滤
多品种数据同步可能存在延迟问题，影响信号时效性
未提供品种间的相关性分析，可能在高度相关品种上重复开仓
cons_en: As a template, core trading strategy logic must be developed by the user, lacking ready-to-use signal system
Multi-symbol simultaneous trading may lead to insufficient margin risk, especially in volatile markets
Lacks advanced risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits and correlation filtering
Multi-symbol data synchronization may have latency issues affecting signal timeliness
No inter-symbol correlation analysis, potentially opening duplicate positions on highly correlated pairs
improvements: 增加品种间相关性过滤机制，避免在高度正相关的货币对上重复开仓
添加整体账户风险控制，包括最大回撤限制和总仓位限额
集成常用技术指标信号模块，使模板开箱即用
improvements_en: Add inter-symbol correlation filtering to avoid duplicate positions on highly correlated currency pairs
Implement portfolio-level risk controls including maximum drawdown limits and total position caps
Integrate common technical indicator signal modules to make the template usable out of the box

risk_points: 多品种同时交易可能在极端行情下导致保证金快速消耗
缺少品种间相关性控制可能导致方向性风险集中
模板默认参数可能不适合所有市场条件，需要充分回测
risk_points_en: Multi-symbol simultaneous trading may rapidly deplete margin in extreme market conditions
Lack of inter-symbol correlation control may concentrate directional risk exposure
Default template parameters may not suit all market conditions, requiring thorough backtesting

summary_en: This is a multi-currency Expert Advisor template for MT5 that allows simultaneous trading across multiple currency pairs from a single chart. It provides a framework for applying trading signals to multiple symbols with configurable parameters for each pair.
